content.short: Game7 DAO supports open gaming infrastructure, developer tooling, and ecosystem growth for onchain games connected to Mantle.
content.description: Game7 DAO is an organization focused on building and supporting open infrastructure for onchain gaming. Its public materials emphasize developer tools, network resources, ecosystem services, and community support aimed at helping games and gaming applications launch with fewer platform bottlenecks. Rather than acting as a single game, Game7 operates as a broader ecosystem layer for builders and players interested in open gaming systems. For Mantle, it fits as gaming infrastructure and coordination support for teams that want tooling, distribution, and resources around blockchain-based game development.
content.meta: Game7 DAO supports open gaming infrastructure, developer tooling, and ecosystem growth for game builders on Mantle.
